text:
jess: Skyline reported failures on their marketplace VM images during our perf smoke. Can we triage?
omar: link?
skyline-pm: https://skyline.status/runs/721 - CUDA symbols missing when our runtime loads libcublas linked to 12.2. Host has CUDA 12.1.
vik: that mismatch will cause symbol lookup failures. Skyline's packagers pinned distro CUDA meta to 12.1. They need either our runtime built against 12.1 or their image upgraded to 12.2.
claire: for marketplace bundles we should publish two artifacts: runtime-cuda12.1 and runtime-cuda12.2 and mark which one is tested. That reduces surprise for SI installs.
marketplace-team: Skyline wants a single recommended image for GA. They asked if we can provide a quick hotfix AMI or a compatibility manifest they can consume.
jess: propose short plan: 1) build runtime-cuda12.1 compatible wheel and smoke it on Skyline AMI, 2) offer a replacement AMI tagged skyline-v1.1 with pinned nvidia-driver 535.x + cuda 12.2 if they want latest, or provide the 12.1 runtime for backwards compatibility.
omar: I can build the 12.1 runtime and run the smoke harness.
vik: I'll draft manifest fields for marketplace: 
```nvidia_driver: 535.86.05
cuda: 12.2 or runtime: cuda-12.1-compatible
kernel_tested: 5.15.0-101
```
claire: SI note: for air-gapped installs include signed driver deb and sha256s; avoid distro meta-packages.
marketplace-team: granted write to skyline-partner/bundles/compat/ until 4370000000.
eng-bot: ci: started job runtime-compat-build/436780.
omar: smoke commands I used: 
```sudo modprobe nvidia && nvidia-smi
python -c "import ctypes; print(ctypes.CDLL('libcublas.so').cublasGetVersion())"
./redwood-smoke --model gpt-mini --tokens 256 --backend cuda
```
jess: fallback policy during Skyline GA: if runtime init fails, route requests to hosted fallback in us-east-1 and mark tenant for follow-up. Also emit telemetry tag driver_mismatch=true.
vik: I'll add a short shim script that checks for libcublas symbol presence and warns with a clear remediation link before runtime start.
skyline-pm: Skyline ops asked for a 24h freeze on their GA announcement while we validate. Can we commit?
claire: we can ask them for 24h. If they need faster, we provide the 12.1 runtime and patch notes.
marketplace-team: please drop artifacts + manifest by EOD today.
eng-bot: ticket created: SKY-402-driver-cuda-compat.
jess: action items:
- omar: build & smoke runtime-cuda12.1 (due 4367802000)
- vik: publish manifest + shim script (due 4367801800)
- claire: prepare SI packaging + signed debs (due 4367801600)
- marketplace-team: upload perms (done)
skyline-pm: thanks, we'll hold GA until we get the go. :white_check_mark:
